# Game Harness

> Release-grade browser QA primitives for TypeScript games: silent Playwright/Vitest sessions, deterministic screenshots, production-runtime proof, and Lighthouse gates.

Game Harness is a focused library, not a test framework. It supplies a
reusable, fail-closed safety and orchestration layer around Playwright and
Vitest Browser Mode; a consuming game keeps its own journeys, assertions,
art direction, and audio engine. Install from npm as
`@jbdevprimary/game-harness`, Node 22 or newer. Import only the subpath
entry point a game needs — the package root stays peer-free and never loads
Playwright or Vitest. See AGENTS.md at the repository root for an
agent-oriented quick reference before writing code against this package.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://jonbogaty.com/game-harness/getting-started/): Installation and the current release/conformance matrix.
- [Quick start](https://jonbogaty.com/game-harness/quick-start/): Wire up the silent runtime marker and a first Playwright config.
- [Entry points](https://jonbogaty.com/game-harness/entry-points/): The full subpath-export map and required peers.
- [Playwright guide](https://jonbogaty.com/game-harness/guides/playwright/): Deterministic ports, strict-port preview servers, device tiers.
- [Vitest Browser Mode guide](https://jonbogaty.com/game-harness/guides/vitest/): Headed real-Chromium Vitest projects.
- [Chromium launch profile & Silent QA guide](https://jonbogaty.com/game-harness/guides/chromium-and-silent-qa/): The peer-free primitives behind every silent browser launch.
- [Production runtime verification guide](https://jonbogaty.com/game-harness/guides/production-runtime/): Turning a build into fail-closed runtime evidence.
- [Visual battery guide](https://jonbogaty.com/game-harness/guides/visual-battery/): Deterministic screenshot baseline orchestration.
- [Lighthouse presets & release ladder guide](https://jonbogaty.com/game-harness/guides/lighthouse-and-release-ladder/): CI Lighthouse assertions and the release-step orchestrator.
- [Architecture reference](https://jonbogaty.com/game-harness/reference/architecture/): Module boundaries, runtime evidence flow, build/distribution guarantees.
- [Troubleshooting reference](https://jonbogaty.com/game-harness/reference/troubleshooting/): Common failure modes and releases/support.
